name: Superior Sheet Metal
old_description: Superior Sheet Metal services the New England area (MA, NH, VT, RI, CT) as a well respected manufacturer of high quality rectangular and spiral duct fittings/air ducts for the heating, ventilating, and air conditioning (HVAC) industry.
about:
Superior Sheet Metal operates from Hudson, New Hampshire, as a veteran-owned fabrication shop serving the New England region. The company produces spiral and rectangular ductwork and fittings for the heating, ventilation, and air conditioning industry, covering Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Vermont, Rhode Island, and Connecticut.

The 25,000-square-foot facility fabricates single- and double-wall duct and fittings from materials including G90 galvanized steel, Galvaneal, stainless steel, aluminum, cold-rolled steel, and PCD-coated steel. The shop handles specialty items and provides free quotes and estimating assistance, with material lifting baskets available for jobsite delivery.

Primary customers are HVAC and mechanical contractors who rely on quick turnaround and on-time delivery throughout New England. The company programs clients into a Nextel system for immediate communication, useful for last-minute changes on projects.

Leadership comes from personnel with hands-on trade experience as installers, shop workers, foremen, and managers, which the company says informs its understanding of contractor needs and product quality.
